question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. stave off.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"stave off"** means to avert or delay something bad or dangerous. (टालना)

 
 
• **Example: **She managed to stave off the cold by wearing a thick coat.
 
 
 
• **"Stave off"** refers to preventing something from happening for a period of time. (टालना)
 
 
• **Example: **The doctor advised him to take vitamins to stave off illness.
 
 
 
• Hence, the most appropriate option to fill in the blank is **'stave off'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Stoved** (स्टोव्ड): This word is not commonly used in English. It could be a past tense of 'stove,' which means to heat or cook in a stove.

 
 
• **Example:** He stoved the beans for dinner.
 
 
 
• **Stave on** (स्टेव ऑन): This phrase is not commonly used in English and does not have a specific meaning.
 
• **Stave of** (स्टेव ऑफ): This seems like a misspelling or incorrect form of "stave off."
